_comment: Seed catalog compiled 2026-10-06 from the task spec + earlier access probe. Everything here is UNVERIFIED until the research note research/<key>.md says otherwise.

datasets.name: BenthicNet (1M / 11M / labelled)
datasets.licence: Per image set (spec: mostly CC BY); umbrella licence is custom per earlier probe. Per-set licences in 00_Documentation/all_licenses_refs.csv
datasets.geo_source: Metadata columns latitude / longitude (WGS 84), ~99.6% filled in BenthicNet-1M; site also given
datasets.size: BenthicNet-1M ~1.3M images; BenthicNet-11M ~11.4M images (size on disk unknown, likely several TB)
datasets.human_steps: FRDR bulk download via Globus (account + Globus Connect Personal), or fetch images from origin URLs in the URL list (doi 10.20383/103.0966)
datasets.verify: Tier per image set; whether the 11M images are hosted on FRDR or only listed as origin URLs; overlap with SQUIDLE+/FathomNet/PANGAEA (record origin URLs for dedup)
questions: What exactly are BenthicNet-1M, BenthicNet-11M and BenthicNet-Labelled and how is each distributed (files, URL lists, tarballs)?
Read 00_Documentation/all_licenses_refs.csv (or equivalent): licence per image set; which sets are CC0/CC BY vs NC/ND/unknown? Share of images in tier A/B.
Exact metadata column names (latitude, longitude, depth, site, datetime, url, dataset/image set id) and CRS.
Can images be fetched per-file over HTTPS (no Globus)? Rate limits? Origin hosts?
Total size of 1M and 11M subsets.

datasets.name: SQUIDLE+ (IMOS AUV and other campaigns)
datasets.licence: IMOS campaigns CC BY 4.0; other campaigns vary - read per campaign
datasets.geo_source: Media pose: lat, lon, dep (verify exact API field names)
datasets.human_steps: Possibly a free SQUIDLE+ API token for some endpoints (verify)
datasets.verify: API field names for pose; per-campaign licence field; whether media URLs are public S3
questions: Which API endpoints list campaigns/deployments/media and their poses? Pagination and filters (q= JSON filters)?
Exact field names for lat/lon/depth/altitude/timestamp on media or pose objects.
Where is licence stored (campaign, platform, deployment)? Which campaigns are CC BY / CC0 (IMOS) vs others?
Are media path_best URLs public (e.g. AODN/IMOS S3)? Any auth or rate limits?
Counts per campaign/platform.

datasets.name: PANGAEA image datasets (seed DOIs + discovery)
datasets.licence: Per DOI (mostly CC BY 4.0); exclude CC BY-NC records; honour moratoria
datasets.geo_source: Latitude / Longitude columns in the data table, or iFDO image-latitude / image-longitude / image-altitude-meters
datasets.human_steps: Some files are on tape and need staging before download; moratorium (embargo) datasets must wait
datasets.verify: Licence + columns per seed DOI; tape staging behaviour
questions: For each seed DOI: title, licence, image count, image URL column, coordinate columns (names, CRS), depth column, moratorium?
Does pangaeapy return the data table with URL columns; how are image files served (hdl/URL column, zip)?
A discovery query for MORE PANGAEA image datasets (keywords: image, photo, OFOS, AUV, seafloor images, iFDO) filtered to CC BY / CC0, excluding NC. List the best ~20 extra DOIs with counts.
How does tape staging work and how can a script detect + request it?

datasets.name: FathomNet
datasets.licence: Per image; keep only CC0 and CC BY; confirm commercial-use terms with MBARI
datasets.geo_source: Image attributes latitude, longitude, depthMeters; geoimages endpoint
datasets.human_steps: Optional: confirm commercial-use terms with MBARI by email
datasets.verify: Share of images with coordinates; where licence is stored per image
questions: fathomnet-py / REST endpoints to enumerate images with lat/lon/depth (geoimages, images/query).
Where is the licence per image (field name) and which values occur? Any NC images?
Share of images with coordinates; rate limits; image URL hosting.
Terms of use for commercial / model-training use.

datasets.name: USGS CMGP Video and Photograph Portal
datasets.geo_source: Trackline navigation files per video/photo set; interpolate video frames by timestamp (segment, geo_inferred)
datasets.region: US coasts (Atlantic, Gulf, Pacific, Hawaii, Alaska)
datasets.human_steps: Portal sits behind Cloudflare (earlier probe); may need manual export of a file list or browser download
datasets.verify: Navigation file format + time base; which releases contain video vs stills
questions: How are the video/photo sets distributed (ScienceBase items, cmgds.marine.usgs.gov)? Can ScienceBase API list them?
Navigation file format (CSV columns, time zone, sampling rate) and how to align video timestamps.
Do stills carry EXIF GPS or a per-photo CSV with lat/lon?
Is scripted access blocked by Cloudflare? Workarounds that stay polite.

datasets.name: CSIRO MNF RV Investigator voyage imagery
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0 (verify per collection); store CSIRO's prescribed attribution sentence
datasets.geo_source: Voyage/station navigation (verify per image vs per station)
datasets.human_steps: CSIRO Data Access Portal may require an order / login for large collections
datasets.verify: Per-image vs per-station positions; DAP API access
questions: Which DAP collections hold underwater imagery (e.g. IN2023_V05 and other voyages)? List them.
Is there a DAP REST API for listing files? Auth needed?
Where are positions: per image metadata, voyage nav files, station logs?
Exact attribution sentence CSIRO prescribes.

datasets.name: Wendtorf / Bottsand GoPro photos (Kiel Bight)
datasets.geo_source: Positions published with the GoPro photos (verify format)
datasets.human_steps: Earlier probe flagged it as needing a person (restricted files?) - verify
datasets.verify: Position format; access restrictions; Baltic weighting
questions: Zenodo record files, sizes, licence, access (open/restricted).
How are positions published (EXIF GPS, CSV, GPX)?

datasets.name: Seatizen Atlas
datasets.licence: Unknown until each session deposit's licence is read
datasets.geo_source: GPS per image in session metadata
datasets.verify: Licence per session deposit (Zenodo); filter out aerial (UAV) images
questions: Where are the session deposits (Zenodo community?) and their licences? Count CC BY/CC0 vs other.
Metadata file per session: GPS column names, depth, which images are aerial vs underwater.
Sizes per session.

datasets.name: German Bight seafloor video (HE415/HE416, HE436, Helgoland 2011)
datasets.geo_source: Station Latitude/Longitude in the PANGAEA data table next to the movie URLs
datasets.human_steps: Video may be on tape: staging request
datasets.verify: Columns, licence, file sizes; tape staging
questions: For PANGAEA.907386, .909999, .831731: licence, columns (station, lat, lon, depth, date, movie URL), number and size of videos.
Do videos have start/end times or tracks that allow better than station precision?
Tape staging status.

datasets.name: NOAA NCRMP benthic photo-quadrats (Pacific, PIFSC)
datasets.licence: US public domain; cite PIFSC Ecosystem Sciences Division
datasets.geo_source: Site metadata LATITUDE / LONGITUDE (diver-recorded), joined on SITE parsed from image name SITE_YEAR_REP_PHOTOID
datasets.region: Hawaii, Mariana Islands, American Samoa, Pacific Remote Islands
datasets.verify: List all NCEI accessions (historical years too); site metadata file name/columns
questions: List all NCEI accessions holding NCRMP Pacific benthic images (all years) and their sizes.
Site metadata file + columns (SITE, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, DEPTH, DATE). Image naming pattern.
Are Atlantic/Caribbean NCRMP image sets also public (Florida, PR, USVI, Flower Garden Banks)?

datasets.name: NOAA Ocean Exploration video portal + Okeanos ROV dive archive
datasets.licence: US public domain unless an item is marked copyright
datasets.geo_source: Dive location from portal metadata; ROV navigation files in per-dive archives (interpolate per segment)
datasets.region: Global deep sea, mostly US EEZ and Pacific
datasets.size: Very large (full dives many TB); sample clips/segments
datasets.verify: Nav file format; clip naming with timestamps; copyright-marked items
questions: Structure of https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/waf/okeanos-rov-cruises/ (cruise/dive folders, video segments, nav CSVs, dive summaries, framegrabs).
ROV nav file format and timestamps; video segment start times (filename?).
Video portal metadata API (dive lat/lon, depth, date).
How copyright-marked items are flagged.
Historical cruises available (years).

datasets.name: Canada open data: DFO Fundy drift video, GSC seafloor photos (+ CKAN discovery)
datasets.geo_source: Transect and station positions in the dataset resources
datasets.region: Bay of Fundy, Scotian Shelf, Canadian waters
datasets.human_steps: Earlier probe flagged a person step (large archives?) - verify
datasets.verify: Resource formats; position files; more datasets via CKAN
questions: Resources of both datasets: formats, sizes, position tables, licence.
CKAN API search (open.canada.ca/data/api/3/action/package_search) for more underwater video/photo datasets with positions; list best candidates.

datasets.name: Australian Antarctic Data Centre underwater imagery
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0 by default; read each record; 'not specified' on a mirror => U
datasets.geo_source: Station positions in each record's metadata
datasets.verify: Which records contain underwater imagery; positions per record
questions: Find AADC metadata records with underwater/benthic photos or video (e.g. CEAMARC, Casey/Davis benthic surveys, towed video). List them with licence + size.
How are positions given (per station table, per image)?
Download mechanism (direct HTTP, data.aad.gov.au/eds/...).

datasets.name: SFishTrack (Mallorca)
datasets.verify: Coordinates per site in paper or deposit
questions: Data deposit location, licence, files, sizes.
Site coordinates (paper table/map or metadata) and mapping video -> site.

datasets.name: HODOR (Kiel Fjord underwater observatory)
datasets.geo_source: Camera coordinates from provider metadata (do not hardcode)
datasets.verify: Coordinates in PANGAEA metadata; archive time range
questions: PANGAEA.980001 + GitHub TAWilts/HODOR: files, licence, time range, camera coordinates/depth.
Is there a longer historical archive of the observatory (other PANGAEA records / years)?

datasets.name: OBSEA seabed camera (Vilanova i la Geltru)
datasets.licence: CC BY (read each yearly Zenodo record)
datasets.geo_source: Station coordinates in ERDDAP / Zenodo metadata
datasets.size: Yearly Zenodo records (https://zenodo.org/communities/obsea/records); include all years
datasets.verify: Licence per yearly record; ERDDAP columns
questions: List all yearly OBSEA image records on Zenodo with licence + size (full history).
ERDDAP dataset columns (time, latitude, longitude, depth, url).
Are there other OBSEA cameras (e.g. buoy camera) with open images?

datasets.name: EMSO-Azores Lucky Strike (SMOOVE / TEMPO)
datasets.region: Lucky Strike vent field, Mid-Atlantic Ridge, 1,695 m
datasets.size: Large tar archives (60 GB+); use range reads / sampling; include all years
datasets.verify: Yearly archives available; tar layout for range reads
questions: All SEANOE records for TEMPO/SMOOVE imagery (all deployment years) with sizes and licences.
Tar/zip layout, file naming with timestamps; possible per-file access.
Camera coordinates + depth in metadata.

datasets.name: Ocean Networks Canada (Oceans 3.0) cameras
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0 for ONC-owned data; partner data varies
datasets.geo_source: Device location code -> lat, lon, depth from the API (ROV dive video may have nav)
datasets.region: NE Pacific (Barkley Canyon, Endeavour, Saanich Inlet, Strait of Georgia), Cambridge Bay (Arctic)
datasets.size: Very large; historical archive since ~2006; sample per day
datasets.human_steps: Free ONC account + API token (env ONC_TOKEN)
datasets.verify: Device categories for cameras; archivefile API; licence per device
questions: API calls to list camera devices (deviceCategoryCode VIDEOCAM, CAMERA, etc.), their locations (lat/lon/depth) and archive files (archivefiles endpoint).
Licence/citation per device; which are partner-owned.
Historical coverage per location; file formats (mp4, jpg) and sizes; how to sample N files per day.

datasets.name: OOI CamHD (Axial Seamount)
datasets.licence: Unknown - hold until confirmed (check OOI data policy)
datasets.region: Axial Seamount, ASHES vent field, ~1,500 m
datasets.size: Very large (14-minute 1080p videos every 3 h since 2016); include history, sample
datasets.verify: OOI licence; instrument coordinates
questions: OOI data licence/terms (is it CC BY 4.0?).
Raw archive layout (year/month/day folders, file sizes), instrument coordinates/depth from OOI metadata API.

datasets.name: Brackish Dataset (Limfjorden)
datasets.geo_source: Camera location from the dataset paper (Pedersen et al. 2019) / provider page
datasets.verify: Camera coordinates from paper; alternative non-Kaggle mirror (AAU)
questions: Licence and files on Kaggle; is there a non-Kaggle mirror?
Camera position (paper gives bridge location / depth?) -> coordinates with uncertainty.

datasets.name: OzFish (AIMS BRUVS)
datasets.licence: Inconsistent: 'not specified' on data.gov.au vs CC BY 3.0 AU in the repository
datasets.geo_source: None per sample; read the publication/metadata for deployment sites
datasets.verify: Licence conflict; deployment coordinates
questions: Resolve licence (repo LICENSE, AIMS metadata record, data.gov.au).
Read the publication / AIMS metadata: are BRUVS deployment sites or regions given? Can video IDs be mapped to sites (filename codes, metadata CSV)?
Assign approx coordinates per video/site with uncertainty (few km OK).

datasets.name: NorFisk
datasets.geo_source: None per sample; read the publication for site(s)
datasets.verify: Entry point, licence, site location
questions: Find the NorFisk dataset publication and deposit (entry point URL), licence, contents.
Read the paper: where were images recorded (farm/site names, coordinates)? Map images to sites; approximate coordinates with uncertainty.

datasets.name: DeepSea MOT
datasets.geo_source: None per sample; read the publication for dive locations
datasets.verify: Entry point, licence, source dives
questions: Find the DeepSea MOT publication and deposit, licence, contents.
Which source videos/dives does it use (e.g. MBARI, NOAA OE)? If source dives are identified, derive dive locations (and per-frame nav if source provides it).

datasets.name: SubPipe (AUV pipeline inspection)
datasets.licence: Zenodo data CC BY 4.0 (code GPL) per earlier probe - confirm
datasets.geo_source: None published per spec; check AUV navigation logs and paper for mission location
datasets.verify: Whether nav logs contain lat/lon; mission location from paper
questions: Zenodo deposit, licence, files and sizes.
Does the dataset include AUV navigation (lat/lon, depth) usable per image? If not, mission location from the paper with uncertainty.

datasets.name: Smithsonian Open Access (in-situ underwater images)
datasets.human_steps: api.data.gov API key for api.si.edu (or use the bulk metadata dump on GitHub/AWS)
datasets.verify: How to find in-situ underwater photos (vs specimen photos); locality fields
questions: How to query CC0 items that are in-situ underwater photographs (e.g. NMNH, deep-sea dives, coral reef surveys) rather than specimen photos.
Which record fields give place/locality/coordinates? How precise?
Bulk metadata dump availability (AWS open data / GitHub).

datasets.name: Wikimedia Commons underwater media (geotagged)
datasets.licence: Per file: PD/CC0 (A), CC BY (B), CC BY-SA (C); exclude NC/ND/fair use
datasets.size: Verify (categories: Underwater photographs, Scuba diving, Coral reefs ...)
datasets.verify: Category tree; share geotagged; licence field (extmetadata LicenseShortName)
questions: Which categories hold in-situ underwater photos/videos? Approx counts and share with coordinates.
API calls: categorymembers + prop=coordinates|imageinfo with extmetadata (licence, artist). Rate-limit etiquette.
Optional region fallback from description/category (e.g. 'Underwater photographs of the Red Sea').

datasets.name: BCO-DMO datasets with imagery
datasets.geo_source: Varies by dataset; only datasets whose media come with coordinates
datasets.verify: Which datasets include media + coordinates
questions: Search BCO-DMO for datasets with underwater photos/video (benthic, coral, ROV/AUV imagery) that have coordinates. List the best with licence and sizes.

datasets.name: NOAA Deep-Sea Coral & Sponge Database (image records)
datasets.licence: NOAA public domain; linked images from partners may differ - verify per record
datasets.verify: ERDDAP endpoint; ImageURL field; image licence per provider
questions: ERDDAP dataset (deepseacoraldata.noaa.gov) fields: ImageURL, latitude, longitude, DepthInMeters, ObservationDate, DataProvider.
Count of records with images; image hosting; licence of images from non-NOAA providers.

datasets.name: NOAA HabCam (NEFSC)
datasets.region: US Northeast shelf (Georges Bank, Mid-Atlantic Bight)
datasets.verify: Whether any HabCam imagery is publicly downloadable
questions: Is HabCam imagery publicly downloadable (NCEI, NOAA Fisheries, AWS Open Data, VIAME sample sets)? With per-image positions? Licence?

datasets.name: MAREANO (Norway) seabed video and stills
datasets.verify: Open download of imagery + positions
questions: Can MAREANO stills/video be downloaded (IMR data portals, NMDC, PANGAEA)? Licence (NLOD?)
Positions per video line/station; formats; sizes.

datasets.name: UK seabed imagery (JNCC / Cefas / BGS via MEDIN)
datasets.licence: Open Government Licence UK v3 (tier B, approved)
datasets.geo_source: Station / image positions in survey metadata (verify)
datasets.verify: Which collections are downloadable with positions
questions: Find downloadable seabed still/video collections with positions under OGL: JNCC offshore surveys, Cefas Data Hub (data.cefas.co.uk), BGS, NatureScot, Marine Scotland. List best with sizes.

datasets.name: SEANOE / Ifremer underwater imagery (beyond SMOOVE)
datasets.licence: Per record (mostly CC BY 4.0; exclude NC)
datasets.verify: Which SEANOE records hold imagery
questions: Search SEANOE for image/video datasets (EMSO-Ligure, Momarsat, deep-sea annotation sets, Ifremer ROV/AUV frames, coastal observatories). List with licence, positions, sizes.

datasets.name: Baltic & Nordic open underwater imagery (scan)
datasets.verify: Discovery task: may spawn new dataset rows
questions: Find openly downloadable underwater image/video with positions from: Finland (SYKE / VELMU drop video), Sweden (SLU, HaV, SMHI, Koster), Denmark (DCE/Aarhus, DTU Aqua), Poland (Pomerania, earlier probe), Germany (GEOMAR, IOW, BSH, Thuenen - DL-DE-BY-2.0), Estonia/Latvia/Lithuania. List each with licence, entry point, positions, sizes.

datasets.name: OOI other cameras (CAMDS digital still cameras etc.)
datasets.licence: Same question as CamHD (OOI data policy)
datasets.verify: Which camera instruments exist in raw archive
questions: List OOI camera instruments (CAMDS, CAMHD, ZPLSC is not a camera) in the raw data archive with locations, years, file types, sizes.
OOI licence.

datasets.name: XL Catlin Seaview Survey / Global Reef Record
datasets.verify: Licence and downloadable imagery
questions: Is Seaview Survey imagery downloadable (UQ eSpace, Global Reef Record)? Licence? Positions per image/transect?

datasets.name: NIWA (New Zealand) seabed imagery
datasets.verify: Downloadable imagery + licence
questions: Find openly downloadable NIWA seabed imagery (DTIS, towed camera, Ross Sea) or NZ open data with positions; licence.

datasets.name: AIMS Long-Term Monitoring / ReefCloud photo transects
datasets.verify: Whether photos are openly downloadable
questions: Are AIMS LTMP / ReefCloud benthic photos downloadable with site positions? Licence? (Also check AIMS data repository and IMOS/AODN.)

datasets.name: Reef Life Survey photo-quadrats
datasets.verify: Whether photo-quadrats are public (AODN, SQUIDLE+ overlap)
questions: Are RLS photo-quadrat images public (AODN/IMOS, SQUIDLE+)? Licence, site coordinates, size; overlap with squidle_imos.

datasets.name: Moorea Coral Reef LTER photo-quadrats
datasets.licence: LTER data policy, typically CC BY 4.0 (verify on EDI)
datasets.verify: Whether raw photo-quadrat images are on EDI / downloadable
questions: Find MCR LTER benthic photo-quadrat image packages (EDI / PASTA, Moorea Labeled Corals). Licence, sizes, years, site coordinates, mapping image -> site.

datasets.name: GBIF / iNaturalist marine occurrence photos
datasets.licence: Per media: keep CC0 / CC BY only
datasets.size: Huge; needs an underwater filter (many photos are not underwater)
datasets.verify: Filter strategy for in-situ underwater photos; obscured coordinates
questions: How to select likely in-situ underwater photos (marine taxa + datasets like Reef Life Survey/iNat with depth/diving fields)? Estimate precision of such a filter.
Media licence fields; coordinate obscuring (iNat geoprivacy); API limits / GBIF download API.

datasets.name: Schmidt Ocean Institute ROV SuBastian imagery
datasets.verify: Licence of video/frame grabs and nav availability
questions: Licence of SOI video and imagery (data repository, MGDS/R2R, Zenodo). Is any downloadable under CC0/CC BY with nav?

datasets.name: JAMSTEC J-EDI deep-sea imagery
datasets.verify: Licence (NC => exclude)
questions: J-EDI terms of use: commercial use allowed? Bulk download allowed? If NC/ND, mark Excluded.

datasets.name: CoralNet public sources
datasets.verify: Licence per source; bulk download terms
questions: CoralNet terms for public sources: is there an explicit licence per source? Is bulk download allowed? Source lat/lon fields.

datasets.name: Koster Seafloor Observatory (Sweden)
datasets.verify: Open deposit + licence
questions: Is the Koster Seafloor Observatory video archive openly deposited (SND, Zenodo, GBIF)? Licence, positions, sizes.

datasets.name: LoVe Ocean Observatory (Norway)
datasets.verify: Open access to camera archive
questions: Is the LoVe camera archive openly downloadable? Licence, node coordinates, years, sizes.

datasets.name: SmartBay Galway Bay cabled observatory (Ireland)
datasets.verify: Open access to camera archive
questions: Is the SmartBay/Marine Institute underwater camera archive downloadable? Licence, coordinates, years, sizes.

datasets.name: ALOHA Cabled Observatory camera (Hawaii)
datasets.region: Station ALOHA, ~4,700 m, north of Oahu
datasets.verify: Open access + licence
questions: Is the ACO camera archive openly downloadable? Licence, coordinates, years, sizes.

datasets.name: DeepFish (JCU, tropical Australia)
datasets.verify: Licence; site mapping from paper
questions: Licence of DeepFish data. Read the paper: habitat/site locations; map folder codes -> sites -> approx coordinates.

datasets.name: Fish4Knowledge (Taiwan fixed cameras)
datasets.geo_source: Camera sites from publication (Kenting, Hobihu, Lanyu)
datasets.verify: Licence (NC => exclude)
questions: Licence/terms for F4K video and ground-truth sets. Camera locations from the papers; video -> camera mapping.
